mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_meeting (id, workspace_id, room_id, title, starts_at, created_by, status, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{roomId}, #{title}, #{startsAt}, #{createdBy}, 'SCHEDULED', NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.workspace_id, w.name AS workspace_name, w.slug AS workspace_slug, m.room_id, m.title, m.starts_at, m.status, m.created_by, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username) AS creator_name, m.created_at FROM workspace_meeting m LEFT JOIN sys_workspace w ON w.id = m.workspace_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.created_by WHERE m.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY m.starts_at DESC

SELECT m.id, m.workspace_id, w.name AS workspace_name, w.slug AS workspace_slug, m.room_id, m.title, m.starts_at, m.status, m.created_by, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username) AS creator_name, m.pre15_pushed_at, m.created_at FROM workspace_meeting_participant p JOIN workspace_meeting m ON m.id = p.meeting_id JOIN sys_workspace w ON w.id = m.workspace_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.created_by WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status <> 'CLOSED' ORDER BY m.starts_at ASC

SELECT m.id, m.workspace_id, w.name AS workspace_name, w.slug AS workspace_slug, m.room_id, m.title, m.starts_at, m.status, m.created_by, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nickname, ''), u.username) AS creator_name, m.invite_pushed_at, m.pre15_pushed_at, m.created_at FROM workspace_meeting m LEFT JOIN sys_workspace w ON w.id = m.workspace_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = m.created_by WHERE m.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace_meeting SET invite_pushed_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND invite_pushed_at IS NULL
UPDATE workspace_meeting SET pre15_pushed_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND pre15_pushed_at IS NULL
UPDATE workspace_meeting SET status = 'OPEN' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'SCHEDULED'
mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id, room_id, title, starts_at, created_by, status FROM workspace_meeting WHERE status = 'SCHEDULED' AND starts_at <= NOW() + INTERVAL '15 minutes'
